/*selectBuyerMpStWarehouseStockList*/ SELECT CAR.BUYER AS BUYER ,(SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = CAR.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME ,CAR.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO ,BYIT.DESCRIPTION_LOC AS DESCRIPTION ,BYIT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M104' AND CODE = BYIT.MAKER_CODE) AS MAKER_NAME ,BYIT.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE ,(CAR.GR_QTY - CAR.IV_QTY) AS STOCK_QTY ,CAR.GR_QTY AS GR_QTY ,CAR.IV_QTY AS IV_QTY ,BYIT.BUYER AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE ,(SELECT CONTRACT_NO FROM ICOMCQDT WHERE BUYER=BYIT.BUYER AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND ROWNUM=1) AS CONTRACT_NO ,(SELECT CONTRACT_SEQ FROM ICOMCQDT WHERE BUYER=BYIT.BUYER AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND ROWNUM=1) AS CONTRACT_SEQ
FROM CAR_STOCK CAR , ICOMBYIT BYIT WHERE 1=1
AND CAR.BUYER IN (SELECT COD3.CODE2 FROM ICOMCOD3 COD3 WHERE COD3.TYPE = 'BGCM' AND COD3.CODE1 = #{st_user_id} AND COD3.TEXT1 = #{st_group_info} AND COD3.FLAG = 'Y')
AND CAR.BUYER = #{st_buyer}
AND CAR.BUYER IN (SELECT COD3.CODE2 FROM ICOMCOD3 COD3 WHERE COD3.TYPE = 'TGCM' AND COD3.CODE1 = #{st_user_id} AND COD3.FLAG = 'Y')
AND CAR.BUYER = #{st_buyer}
AND BYIT.BUYER = (SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = CAR.BUYER) AND BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = CAR.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND BYIT.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' AND BYIT.STATUS != 'D' AND CAR.STATUS != 'D'
AND BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%'
AND BYIT.DESCRIPTION_LOC LIKE '%' || #{st_description} || '%'
AND BYIT.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%' || #{st_specification} || '%'
ORDER BY 2,3
